name: Wardrobe cosmetics: a shapeshift takes the wings off only while it lasts
contract: Appearance 2030 (Blossom Gossamer Wings) resolves to cosmetic aura 286530. While the character wears
another form, the client drops the cosmetic aura with a cancel. That cancel must not clear the saved
selection, and the wardrobe refresh does not put the wings on the form. Once the character is back
in their own form, the refresh puts the wings back within 2 s. A cancel in the character's own form

steps.label: The selected wings apply their cosmetic aura
